newsitem.title: USA: Core Labs says 83 pct of Pickford tendered.
newsitem.headline: Core Labs says 83 pct of Pickford tendered.

text.p: Core Laboratories NV said Wednesday that it has successfully been tendered over 83 percent of the outstanding shares of Scott Pickford Plc.

The company said shares have been tendered to Core at 59 pence each in response to Core's unconditional offer for all shares of Scott Pickford, and that it believes that over 90 percent of the stock will be tendered within two weeks.
At that time Core will have the ability to acquire all remaining outstanding shares under English law.
Scott Pickford, based in London with offices in Aberdeen, Leeds and Houston, offers geological, geophysical and engineering services and products.
Core Laboratories provides petroleum reservoir description data and production management services for maximizing hydrocarbon recovery.
